mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (measured as the 3-month change) signals an easing monetary policy, reducing the discount rate for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where the 3-month FEDFUNDS change is negative, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL value above 245.0 indicates high inflation, prompting central bank tightening and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 245.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a contraction in the real economy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 104.0 and HOUST < 1240.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A late-cycle expansion regime (UNRATE < 4.0% and rising > 0.2pp in 3 months) signals labor market tightness and impending monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4.0% and UNRATE rising > 0.2pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0% and UNRATE rising > 0.2pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer demand and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between HOUST and 5-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A UNRATE above 5.0% indicates a weak labor market and potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS > 474000.0 and HOUST > 1240.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), central bank policy is restrictive, reducing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
